name: Susmita Patel

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Susmita Patel writes poetry and fiction in Odia. In a 2022 interview with Odisha Sambad, she traced her early interest in writing to storybooks her father brought home, her village library and her mother’s encouragement. The interview identifies books including ଆଞ୍ଜୁଳାଏ ସ୍ମୃତି and ଡାଏରୀ, and records her interest in songs, children’s verse, stories and novels.

Her Kabita Live poem “କାମନାର ବିନାଶ” questions what renunciation means for someone left carrying a household’s responsibilities. Addressing a prince who can leave home in search of awakening, the speaker asks who will bear the obligations he leaves behind. The poem brings the desire for peace into conversation with care, attachment and the unequal freedom to walk away.
